hardeningClaims: Containing directories are fsynced after immutable file creation, directory creation, journal or target rename, and owner-lock publication or removal.
Directory-fsync failure is reported as an unsuccessful or uncertain effect and does not produce a false success result.
A prepared journal remains available for reconciliation after uncertain target or commit-record durability outcomes.
The owner lock serializes callers using this workflow only; this implementation does not claim protection against arbitrary noncooperating writers racing after the final preimage check.

durabilityFailureCases: directory fsync failure before target publication leaves no canonical write
directory fsync failure after target rename returns no success and replay observes without redispatch
journal directory fsync failure after commit record rename returns no success and replay does not redispatch
